title: Transferring to Singapore Embryos that have Undergone Pre-implantation Genetically Screens Overseas during COVID-19 Pandemic
what_it_is: Transferring to Singapore Embryos that have Undergone Pre-implantation Genetically Screens Overseas during COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: Importing screened embryos from overseas
sections.summary: MOH may exceptionally allow import of pre-implantation genetically screened embryos stored overseas if overseas centres meet AR licensing conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: During the pandemic, MOH received appeals from some couples to import their pre-implantation genetically screened embryos stored overseas.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In reviewing each appeal, the Ministry considered whether processes and standards employed by overseas assisted reproduction (AR) centres are aligned to Singapore’s regulatory requirements under the Licensing Terms and Conditions for AR Services (AR LTCs).

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry may on an exceptional basis allow importation of the embryos, subject to conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These conditions include: (a) declaration by the overseas AR centre that the relevant requirements under the AR LTCs, including the handling, processing and storage of the embryos, are adhered to; (b) that no other findings besides the presence or absence of chromosomal aberrations are reported, and (c) proper documentation of the screening test results that were provided to the patient and attending physician in our local AR centres.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Local AR centres which receive the tested embryos must also continue to ensure compliance with the AR LTCs.

sections.label: Appeals to Ministry of Health
sections.summary: Applicants typically write to MOH to appeal and receive requirements, and MOH will consider making information more accessible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Typically, the applicants or those who are asking for this will usually just write in to appeal to the Ministry of Health and we would provide them the answer and tell them what the necessary requirements are.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But we can look into the suggestion and see how this information can be made more accessible, and perhaps, a form that is simplified for the purposes of this application.
